name: Basics Tutorial Script
description: Step-by-step guided walkthrough of the core game mechanics.

steps.title: Hail, Apprentice Architect!
steps.message: In DDDnD, you are the Domain Architect — a strategic hero who shapes software realms through tough decisions. Each turn you'll cast an Action Scroll that shifts your realm's vital scores. Manage tradeoffs wisely, and the realm prospers. Let us begin your training!

steps.title: Cast Your First Scroll
steps.message: Your Action Satchel holds the scrolls available this turn. Each scroll affects your realm's scores — some rise, others may fall. For your first incantation, play the glowing scroll: Plan Ahead. It strengthens Code Clarity and System Health and plants a delayed boon that arrives in two turns.

steps.title: The Realm Responds!
steps.message: Behold the score bars — Code Clarity and System Health have risen! These scores are the lifeblood of your realm. Every scroll carries tradeoffs: bolstering one pillar may weaken another. Your planning also conjured an Architectural Aftershock — a delayed effect that will materialize on Turn 3.

steps.title: Win the Council's Favor
steps.message: The council watches over your realm. When scores cross certain thresholds, they react — granting boons or imposing penalties. Now play Ship a Feature to raise Stakeholder Trust and earn the Product Owner's blessing!

steps.title: A Patron Smiles Upon You!
steps.message: The Product Owner has granted you a boon! Each member of the council has hidden rules — cross their thresholds and they'll reward or punish you. Keeping the council satisfied (or at least not hostile) is a pillar of your strategy.

steps.title: An Aftershock Is Coming
steps.message: The Plan Ahead you played on turn 1 planted a delayed effect. It lands this turn as an Architectural Aftershock — lightning on the table, then a plaque. Play Clean Up the Code to take your turn and watch it arrive. You will see your card first, then the storm from the past.

steps.title: That Was the Aftershock
steps.message: The lightning and the plaque were the delayed boon from Plan Ahead. Past decisions echo forward, for good or ill. That is an Architectural Aftershock: not a new card, last turn catching up.

steps.title: Quest Complete, Apprentice!
steps.message: Well fought! You've seen the core loop: play from the hand, the system answers, the council speaks, and aftershocks catch up later. Every decision carries tradeoffs — that is the heart of Domain Architecture. The real quests await!
